Ui.Script:
BINDING_HEADER_KARTCRAFT = "World of Kartcraft" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_ACCELERATE = "Accelerate" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_BRAKE = "Brake / Reverse" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_STEERLEFT = "Steer Left" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_STEERRIGHT = "Steer Right" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_HOP = "Hop / Powerslide" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_BOOST = "Boost (Second Shoulder)" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_FIRE = "Fire Item" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_ABILITY1 = "Wumpa Juice" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_ABILITY2 = "Turbo Boost" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_ABILITY3 = "Super Engine" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_ABILITY4 = "Aku Aku" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_SUMMON = "Summon / Dismiss Kart" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_RACEFINDER = "Race Finder" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_LEAVERACE = "Leave Race" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_SETTINGS = "Kartcraft Settings" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_GARAGE = "Kart Garage" BENILLA_KART_PREFIX = "KARTCRAFT" -- What the finder offers, { key, name } in the kart's order, from BENILLA_KART_COURSES: -- the zones, keyed "z<place>". BenillaKartCourses = {} -- Every course's name by key, from BENILLA_KART_COURSE_NAMES. BenillaKartCourseNames = {} -- The rows the list shows at once, and their height. BENILLA_KART_ROWS = 8 BENILLA_KART_ROW_HEIGHT = 24 BENILLA_KART_HEARTBEAT = 2 BENILLA_KART_RACING = "You're in a race: finish it, or leave it with /leaverace, first." BENILLA_KART_XP_COLOR = { r = 111 / 255, g = 111 / 255, b = 1 } BENILLA_KART_SKILL_COLOR = { r = 0.4, g = 0.8, b = 1 }
-- The finder's state: what is ticked (by course key, so a scroll moves no tick), what we -- queued for and the server's word on it. BenillaKartFinder = { any = 1, picked = {}, beat = 0, noticeUntil = 0, search = "" }
function BenillaKart_Send(body) SendAddonMessage(BENILLA_KART_PREFIX, "R\t" .. body, "PARTY") end
-- Out of every race and the queue, whatever the kart or the server thinks. function BenillaKart_LeaveRace() BenillaKart_Send("X") end
-- `text` cut at each TAB. function BenillaKart_Split(text) local out, from = {}, 1 while true do local at = string.find(text, "\t", from, 1) if not at then table.insert(out, string.sub(text, from)) return out end table.insert(out, string.sub(text, from, at - 1)) from = at + 1 end end
function BenillaKart_CourseName(key) if BenillaKartCourseNames[key] then return BenillaKartCourseNames[key] end for i = 1, table.getn(BenillaKartCourses) do if BenillaKartCourses[i].key == key then return BenillaKartCourses[i].name end end if key == "any" then return "any course" end return key end
-- "any", or the ticked courses' keys. function BenillaKartFinder_Keys() local f = BenillaKartFinder local keys = "" if not f.any then for i = 1, table.getn(BenillaKartCourses) do local key = BenillaKartCourses[i].key if f.picked[key] then if keys ~= "" then keys = keys .. "," end keys = keys .. key end end end if keys == "" then return "any" end return keys end
function BenillaKartFinder_Queue() local f = BenillaKartFinder f.queued = BenillaKartFinder_Keys() f.waiting, f.waited, f.noticeUntil = nil, nil, 0 BenillaKart_Send("Q+\t" .. f.queued) f.beat = GetTime() + BENILLA_KART_HEARTBEAT end
function BenillaKartFinder_Leave() local f = BenillaKartFinder f.queued, f.waiting, f.waited = nil, nil, nil BenillaKart_Send("Q-") end
-- A tick: nil is "Any course", else a course's key. Changing the courses while queued -- keeps the place. function BenillaKartFinder_Pick(key) local f = BenillaKartFinder if not key then f.any, f.picked = 1, {} else if f.picked[key] then f.picked[key] = nil else f.picked[key] = 1 end f.any = nil if not next(f.picked) then f.any = 1 end end if f.queued then BenillaKartFinder_Queue() end BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end
function BenillaKartFinder_QueueClick() if BenillaKartFinder.queued then BenillaKartFinder_Leave() else BenillaKartFinder_Queue() end BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end
function BenillaKartFinder_Answer(accept) local f = BenillaKartFinder local check = f.check if not check or check.answered then return end check.answered = 1 if accept then BenillaKart_Send("Y\t" .. check.id) else BenillaKart_Send("N\t" .. check.id) f.check, f.queued = nil, nil end end
function BenillaKartFinder_Toggle() if BenillaKartFinderFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartFinderFrame:Hide() else BenillaKart_Open(BenillaKartFinderFrame) end end
-- The status line: the ready check, a refusal, the queue, or how to start. function BenillaKartFinder_Status() local f = BenillaKartFinder if f.check then if f.check.answered then return "Race ready: waiting for the others..." end return "Race ready: " .. BenillaKart_CourseName(f.check.course) end if not f.queued then if GetTime() < f.noticeUntil then return BENILLA_KART_RACING end return "Pick zones and find a race." end local names = "" local keys = BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(f.queued, ",", "\t")) for i = 1, table.getn(keys) do if names ~= "" then names = names .. ", " end names = names .. BenillaKart_CourseName(keys[i]) end -- A long pick reads as a count; the ticks in the list say which. if table.getn(keys) > 3 then names = table.getn(keys) .. " zones" end if not f.waited then return "In queue: " .. names end return format("In queue: %s\n%d:%02d, %d waiting", names, floor(f.waited / 60), mod(f.waited, 60), f.waiting) end
function BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() local frame = BenillaKartFinderFrame if not frame:IsVisible() then return end local f = BenillaKartFinder getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrameAny"):SetChecked(f.any) BenillaKartFinder_UpdateList() if f.queued then BenillaKartFinderFrameQueue:SetText("Leave queue") BenillaKartFinderFrameClose:SetText("Minimize") else BenillaKartFinderFrameQueue:SetText("Find race") BenillaKartFinderFrameClose:SetText("Close") end BenillaKartFinderFrameStatus:SetText(BenillaKartFinder_Status()) end
-- What the list shows: every entry whose name holds the search, any case. function BenillaKartFinder_Shown() local search = string.lower(BenillaKartFinder.search or "") if search == "" then return BenillaKartCourses end local shown = {} for i = 1, table.getn(BenillaKartCourses) do local course = BenillaKartCourses[i] if string.find(string.lower(course.name), search, 1, 1) then table.insert(shown, course) end end return shown end
-- The search box's text: the list filters and goes back to its head. function BenillaKartFinder_Search(text) BenillaKartFinder.search = text or "" local bar = getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrameScrollScrollBar") if bar then bar:SetValue(0) end BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end
-- The course rows over the list from the scroll's offset; the stock faux kit's bar where it -- is loaded, else the list's head. function BenillaKartFinder_UpdateList() local list = BenillaKartFinder_Shown() local count = table.getn(list) local offset = 0 if FauxScrollFrame_Update then local scroll = BenillaKartFinderFrameScroll FauxScrollFrame_Update(scroll, count, BENILLA_KART_ROWS, BENILLA_KART_ROW_HEIGHT) if BenillaScrollTrough_Follow then BenillaScrollTrough_Follow(scroll:GetName()) end offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scroll) end for i = 1, BENILLA_KART_ROWS do local row = getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrameRow" .. i) local course = list[offset + i] if course then row.key = course.key local label = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Text") if label then label:SetText(course.name) end row:SetChecked(BenillaKartFinder.picked[course.key]) row:Show() else row.key = nil row:Hide() end end end
function BenillaKartFinder_OnMouseWheel(delta) if BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel then BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(BenillaKartFinderFrameScroll, delta) end end
-- BENILLA_KART_COURSE_NAMES: every course, one "key<TAB>name" a line. function BenillaKartCourseNames_Set(list) BenillaKartCourseNames = {} local lines = BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(list or "", "\n", "\t")) for i = 1, table.getn(lines) - 1, 2 do BenillaKartCourseNames[lines[i]] = lines[i + 1] end end
-- BENILLA_KART_COURSES: one "key<TAB>name" a line, in one argument, so a long list fits. function BenillaKartCourses_Set(list) BenillaKartCourses = {} local lines = BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(list or "", "\n", "\t")) for i = 1, table.getn(lines) - 1, 2 do table.insert(BenillaKartCourses, { key = lines[i], name = lines[i + 1] }) end BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end
-- Each race's course key by race id, from the server's "C". BenillaKartRaceCourse = {}
-- A finish that beat a best ("r" a course record, "p" a personal best) goes to the chat: -- anyone's record, and our own best. function BenillaKart_Finished(race, name, ms, best) if not DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME or not ms or (best ~= "r" and best ~= "p") then return end local time = format("%d:%02d.%02d", floor(ms / 60000), mod(floor(ms / 1000), 60), floor(mod(ms, 1000) / 10)) local course = BenillaKart_CourseName(BenillaKartRaceCourse[race or ""] or "") if best == "r" then DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(format("%s set a new course record on %s: %s!", name, course, time), 1, 0.82, 0) elseif name == UnitName("player") then DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(format("New personal best on %s: %s.", course, time), 1, 0.82, 0) end end
-- ── The track browser ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Every course from BENILLA_KART_TRACKS: { key, name, zone, map, laps, text, points }, -- searchable; "Show on map" opens the world map at the course's zone and draws its route, -- which GetWorldLocMapPosition puts on whatever map is displayed. The route goes when the -- map closes or another course is shown. BenillaKartTracks = {} BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROWS = 10 BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROW_HEIGHT = 18 -- The trail's dot every this many yards along the route. BENILLA_KART_ROUTE_STEP = 15 BenillaKartTrackBrowser = { search = "" } -- The course on the map (its key), and its dots. BenillaKartRoute = { dots = {} }
function BenillaKartTracks_Set(list) BenillaKartTracks = {} local lines = BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(list or "", "\n", "\t")) for i = 1, table.getn(lines) - 6, 7 do local points = {} local items = BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(lines[i + 6], ";", "\t")) for j = 1, table.getn(items) do local comma = string.find(items[j], ",", 1, 1) if comma then table.insert(points, { tonumber(string.sub(items[j], 1, comma - 1)), tonumber(string.sub(items[j], comma + 1)) }) end end table.insert(BenillaKartTracks, { key = lines[i], name = lines[i + 1], zone = lines[i + 2], map = tonumber(lines[i + 3]) or 0, laps = tonumber(lines[i + 4]) or 0, text = lines[i + 5], points = points }) end BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Refresh() end
function BenillaKartTrack(key) for i = 1, table.getn(BenillaKartTracks) do if BenillaKartTracks[i].key == key then return BenillaKartTracks[i] end end end
-- The list: every track whose name or zone holds the search, any case. function BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Shown() local search = string.lower(BenillaKartTrackBrowser.search or "") if search == "" then return BenillaKartTracks end local shown = {} for i = 1, table.getn(BenillaKartTracks) do local t = BenillaKartTracks[i] if string.find(string.lower(t.name .. " " .. t.zone), search, 1, 1) then table.insert(shown, t) end end return shown end
function BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Search(text) BenillaKartTrackBrowser.search = text or "" local bar = getglobal("BenillaKartTracksFrameScrollScrollBar") if bar then bar:SetValue(0) end BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Refresh() end
-- Opens the browser at `key` (the Race Marshal's own course), its row brought into view. function BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Open(key) BenillaKartTrackBrowser.selected = key or BenillaKartTrackBrowser.selected BenillaKart_Open(BenillaKartTracksFrame) if not BenillaKartTracksFrame:IsVisible() then return end if key then local list = BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Shown() for i = 1, table.getn(list) do if list[i].key == key then local bar = getglobal("BenillaKartTracksFrameScrollScrollBar") if bar and i > BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROWS then bar:SetValue((i - 1) * BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROW_HEIGHT) end end end end BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Refresh() end
function BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Toggle() if BenillaKartTracksFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartTracksFrame:Hide() else BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Open() end end
function BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Select(key) BenillaKartTrackBrowser.selected = key BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Refresh() end
function BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Refresh() local frame = BenillaKartTracksFrame if not frame or not frame:IsVisible() then return end local list = BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Shown() local offset = 0 if FauxScrollFrame_Update then local scroll = BenillaKartTracksFrameScroll FauxScrollFrame_Update(scroll, table.getn(list), BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROWS, BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROW_HEIGHT) if BenillaScrollTrough_Follow then BenillaScrollTrough_Follow(scroll:GetName()) end offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scroll) end local selected = BenillaKartTrackBrowser.selected for i = 1, BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROWS do local row = getglobal("BenillaKartTracksFrameRow" .. i) local track = list[offset + i] if track then row.key = track.key getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Name"):SetText(track.name) getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Zone"):SetText(track.zone) if track.key == selected then row:LockHighlight() else row:UnlockHighlight() end row:Show() else row.key = nil row:Hide() end end local track = selected and BenillaKartTrack(selected) if track then BenillaKartTracksFrameTitle:SetText(track.name) BenillaKartTracksFrameText:SetText(track.text) BenillaKartTracksFrameShow:Enable() else BenillaKartTracksFrameTitle:SetText("") BenillaKartTracksFrameText:SetText("Pick a track to read about it and see it on the map.") BenillaKartTracksFrameShow:Disable() end if BenillaKartRoute.key and BenillaKartRoute.key == selected then BenillaKartTracksFrameShow:SetText("Shown on the map") else BenillaKartTracksFrameShow:SetText("Show on map") end end
function BenillaKartTrackBrowser_OnMouseWheel(delta) if BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel then BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(BenillaKartTracksFrameScroll, delta) end end
-- The route's layer on the world map's canvas, made on first use; it hides with the map, -- and its OnHide takes the route away. function BenillaKartRoute_Layer() if BenillaKartRouteFrame then return BenillaKartRouteFrame end if not WorldMapButton then return nil end local layer = CreateFrame("Frame", "BenillaKartRouteFrame", WorldMapButton) layer:SetAllPoints(WorldMapButton) layer:SetFrameLevel(WorldMapButton:GetFrameLevel() + 2) layer:RegisterEvent("WORLD_MAP_UPDATE") layer:SetScript("OnEvent", function() BenillaKartRoute_Draw() end) layer:SetScript("OnHide", function() BenillaKartRoute_Clear() -- A browser that rode on the map goes back to the screen, still open. if BenillaKartTracksFrame:GetParent() == WorldMapFrame then BenillaKartTracksFrame:SetParent(UIParent) BenillaKartTracksFrame:SetFrameStrata("FULLSCREEN_DIALOG") end end) return layer end
function BenillaKartRoute_Clear() for i = 1, table.getn(BenillaKartRoute.dots) do BenillaKartRoute.dots[i]:Hide() end if BenillaKartRouteStart then BenillaKartRouteStart:Hide() end BenillaKartRoute.key = nil BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Refresh() end
-- A dot of the trail, the pool grown as a route needs. function BenillaKartRoute_Dot(layer, n) local dot = BenillaKartRoute.dots[n] if not dot then dot = layer:CreateTexture(nil, "OVERLAY") BenillaKartRoute.dots[n] = dot end return dot end
-- Puts a dot at world (x, y) on the displayed map, or hides it off the map. function BenillaKartRoute_Place(layer, dot, map, x, y, size, r, g, b) local u, v = GetWorldLocMapPosition(map, x, y) if u == 0 and v == 0 then dot:Hide() return end dot:SetTexture(r, g, b, 1) dot:SetWidth(size) dot:SetHeight(size) dot:ClearAllPoints() dot:SetPoint("CENTER", layer, "TOPLEFT", u * layer:GetWidth(), -v * layer:GetHeight()) dot:Show() end
-- The shown course's trail on the displayed map: a dot each ROUTE_STEP yards along it, -- bigger at the checkpoints, the start marked; again at every map change. function BenillaKartRoute_Draw() local track = BenillaKartRoute.key and BenillaKartTrack(BenillaKartRoute.key) local layer = BenillaKartRouteFrame if not track or not layer then return end local points = track.points local count = table.getn(points) local n = 0 -- A circuit runs back to its first checkpoint; a sprint ends at its last. local legs = count - 1 if track.laps > 0 then legs = count end for i = 1, legs do local a, b = points[i], points[mod(i, count) + 1] local length = math.sqrt((b[1] - a[1]) ^ 2 + (b[2] - a[2]) ^ 2) local steps = math.max(1, floor(length / BENILLA_KART_ROUTE_STEP)) for k = 0, steps - 1 do local t = k / steps n = n + 1 local size, r, g, bl = 3, 1, 0.55, 0.1 if k == 0 then size, r, g, bl = 6, 1, 0.85, 0.1 end BenillaKartRoute_Place(layer, BenillaKartRoute_Dot(layer, n), track.map, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t, size, r, g, bl) end end if legs < count and count > 0 then n = n + 1 local last = points[count] BenillaKartRoute_Place(layer, BenillaKartRoute_Dot(layer, n), track.map, last[1], last[2], 8, 0.9, 0.2, 0.2) end for i = n + 1, table.getn(BenillaKartRoute.dots) do BenillaKartRoute.dots[i]:Hide() end if not BenillaKartRouteStart then BenillaKartRouteStart = layer:CreateTexture("BenillaKartRouteStart", "OVERLAY") end if count > 0 then BenillaKartRoute_Place(layer, BenillaKartRouteStart, track.map, points[1][1], points[1][2], 10, 0.2, 1, 0.2) end end
-- The world map's zone for a course: its continent by map id, its zone by name. function BenillaKartRoute_Zoom(track) if not GetMapContinents or not SetMapZoom then return end local want = "Eastern Kingdoms" if track.map == 1 then want = "Kalimdor" end local continents = { GetMapContinents() } for c = 1, table.getn(continents) do if continents[c] == want then local zones = { GetMapZones(c) } for z = 1, table.getn(zones) do if zones[z] == track.zone then SetMapZoom(c, z) return end end SetMapZoom(c) return end end end
-- "Show on map": the world map opens at the course's zone with its route, the last one -- taken away. function BenillaKartRoute_Show(key) local track = BenillaKartTrack(key) if not track then return end local layer = BenillaKartRoute_Layer() if not layer then return end BenillaKartRoute_Clear() if WorldMapFrame and not WorldMapFrame:IsVisible() then -- The map is a full-screen panel: it hides UIParent and every window with it. The -- browser rides on the map while it is up, and goes back when it closes. local browsing = BenillaKartTracksFrame:IsVisible() if ToggleWorldMap then ToggleWorldMap() else WorldMapFrame:Show() end if browsing then BenillaKartTracksFrame:SetParent(WorldMapFrame) BenillaKartTracksFrame:SetFrameStrata("FULLSCREEN_DIALOG") BenillaKartTracksFrame:Show() end end BenillaKartRoute.key = key BenillaKartRoute_Zoom(track) BenillaKartRoute_Draw() BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Refresh() end
-- The server's replies. function BenillaKartFinder_OnLine(message) local f = BenillaKartFinder local line = BenillaKart_Split(message) if line[1] ~= "R" then return end local verb = line[2] if verb == "Qs" then f.waiting, f.waited = tonumber(line[3]), tonumber(line[4]) elseif verb == "Qx" then f.queued, f.waiting, f.waited = nil, nil, nil if line[3] == "racing" then f.noticeUntil = GetTime() + 6 end elseif verb == "Pop" then f.check = { id = line[3], course = line[4], racers = tonumber(line[5]) or 0 } if StaticPopupDialogs then StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_KART_READY"].timeout = tonumber(line[6]) or 20 StaticPopup_Show("BENILLA_KART_READY", BenillaKart_CourseName(line[4]), f.check.racers) end elseif verb == "Pop-" then -- The server queues again those who accepted. if f.check and not f.check.answered then f.queued = nil end f.check = nil if StaticPopup_Hide then StaticPopup_Hide("BENILLA_KART_READY") end elseif verb == "Finder" then -- The Race Marshal's "Open the Race Finder". BenillaKart_Open(BenillaKartFinderFrame) elseif verb == "Tracks" then -- The Race Marshal's "Browse the tracks", at her own course. BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Open(line[3] ~= "" and line[3] or nil) elseif verb == "X" then -- Out of every race and the queue (/leaverace, the minimap button's menu). f.check, f.queued, f.waiting, f.waited = nil, nil, nil, nil if StaticPopup_Hide then StaticPopup_Hide("BENILLA_KART_READY") end if DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME then DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage("You left every race and the Race Finder queue.", 1, 0.82, 0) end elseif verb == "C" then -- A race's course, to name it when someone sets a record there. BenillaKartRaceCourse[line[3] or ""] = line[4] elseif verb == "F" then BenillaKart_Finished(line[3], line[4], tonumber(line[6]), line[7]) elseif verb == "Ret" then -- Our Race Finder race is over: back to where it took us from? if StaticPopup_Show then StaticPopup_Show("BENILLA_KART_RETURN") end elseif verb == "L" then -- A roster with us in it: we are in a race, so the finder is done and closes. local me = UnitName("player") if me and string.find("," .. (line[4] or "") .. ",", "," .. me .. ",", 1, 1) then f.check, f.queued, f.waiting, f.waited = nil, nil, nil, nil if StaticPopup_Hide then StaticPopup_Hide("BENILLA_KART_READY") end BenillaKartFinderFrame:Hide() end end BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end
-- A widget the player drags with the left button; its place is kept between sessions, -- as a user-placed frame's is (layout-local.txt). -- Our windows open as a stock non-centre panel does: refused while a centre panel (the -- game menu, the options window) holds the screen (`UIParent.lua:654-656`). function BenillaKart_Open(frame) if CanOpenPanels and not CanOpenPanels() then return end frame:Show() end
function BenillaKart_Movable(frame) frame:SetMovable(1) frame:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") end
-- The banner, and the results as a board: one line a racer, the board as tall as them. function BenillaKartRace_Show(banner, results) BenillaKartRaceBanner:SetText(banner or "") results = results or "" BenillaKartRaceResults:SetText(results) if results == "" then BenillaKartResultsFrame:Hide() return end local lines = table.getn(BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(results, "\n", "\t"))) BenillaKartResultsFrame:SetHeight(44 + lines * 16) BenillaKartResultsFrame:Show() end
-- The chain: its latest trick, its points, then the experience and skill it earned. function BenillaKartScore_Show(trick, tr, tg, tb, points, pr, pg, pb, xp, skill, alpha) if not trick then BenillaKartScoreFrame:Hide() return end BenillaKartScoreTrick:SetText(trick) BenillaKartScoreTrick:SetTextColor(tr, tg, tb) BenillaKartScorePoints:SetText(points) BenillaKartScorePoints:SetTextColor(pr, pg, pb) BenillaKartScoreXp:SetText(xp) BenillaKartScoreSkill:SetText(skill) BenillaKartScoreFrame:SetAlpha(alpha) BenillaKartScoreFrame:Show() end
function BenillaKartEvents_OnEvent() if event == "CHAT_MSG_ADDON" then if arg1 == BENILLA_KART_PREFIX then BenillaKartFinder_OnLine(arg2) end elseif event == "BENILLA_KART_RACE" then BenillaKartRace_Show(arg1, arg2) elseif event == "BENILLA_KART_SCORE" then BenillaKartScore_Show(arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7, arg8, arg9, arg10, arg11) elseif event == "BENILLA_KART_TRACKS" then BenillaKartTracks_Set(arg1) elseif event == "BENILLA_KART_COURSES" then BenillaKartCourses_Set(arg1) elseif event == "BENILLA_KART_COURSE_NAMES" then BenillaKartCourseNames_Set(arg1) elseif event == "BENILLA_KART_GARAGE" then BenillaKartGarage_Set(arg1, arg2, arg3) end end
-- The queue in a line, for the minimap button's tooltip: nil when there is none. function BenillaKartFinder_Brief() local f = BenillaKartFinder if f.check then return "Race Finder: race ready" end if not f.queued then return nil end if not f.waited then return "Race Finder: in queue" end return format("Race Finder: %d:%02d, %d waiting", floor(f.waited / 60), mod(f.waited, 60), f.waiting or 0) end
-- ── The minimap button, on the ring as an addon's is ──
-- Its centre's distance from the minimap's: the ring the stock buttons sit on. BENILLA_KART_MINIMAP_RADIUS = 80
-- At `angle` (degrees counter-clockwise from east), else at KartMinimapAngle. function BenillaKartMinimap_Place(angle) angle = math.rad(angle or tonumber(GetCVar("KartMinimapAngle")) or 190) local button = BenillaKartMinimapButton button:ClearAllPoints() button:SetPoint("CENTER", "Minimap", "CENTER", BENILLA_KART_MINIMAP_RADIUS * math.cos(angle), BENILLA_KART_MINIMAP_RADIUS * math.sin(angle)) end
-- The cursor's angle about the minimap's centre, 0 to 360. function BenillaKartMinimap_CursorAngle() local x, y = GetCursorPosition() local scale = Minimap:GetEffectiveScale() local cx, cy = Minimap:GetCenter() local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(y / scale - cy, x / scale - cx)) if angle < 0 then angle = angle + 360 end return angle end
function BenillaKartMinimap_DragStop() local button = BenillaKartMinimapButton button.dragging = nil BenillaKartSettings_Set("KartMinimapAngle", BenillaKartMinimap_CursorAngle(), 0) BenillaKartMinimap_Place() end
-- Shown as KartMinimapButton says. function BenillaKartMinimap_Apply() if GetCVar("KartMinimapButton") == "0" then BenillaKartMinimapButton:Hide() else BenillaKartMinimapButton:Show() end end
function BenillaKartMinimap_Hide() SetCVar("KartMinimapButton", "0") BenillaKartMinimap_Apply() if DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME then DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage("Kartcraft's minimap button is hidden: /kartcraft shows it again.", 1, 0.82, 0) end end
function BenillaKartMinimap_OnClick(button) GameTooltip:Hide() if button == "RightButton" then ToggleDropDownMenu(1, nil, BenillaKartMinimapDropDown, "BenillaKartMinimapButton", 10, -5) else BenillaKartFinder_Toggle() end end
function BenillaKartMinimap_Tooltip() local button = BenillaKartMinimapButton GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_LEFT") GameTooltip:SetText("World of Kartcraft") local brief = BenillaKartFinder_Brief() if brief then GameTooltip:AddLine(brief, 1, 1, 1) end GameTooltip:AddLine("Click for the Race Finder, right-click for more; drag to move.", 0.8, 0.8, 0.8) GameTooltip:Show() button.shownTip = button.tooltip end
-- Each frame: the tooltip's line (the stock queue button's `tooltip`), the glow while -- queued and its flash while a race is ready, and the drag around the ring. function BenillaKartMinimap_Update() local button = BenillaKartMinimapButton local f = BenillaKartFinder button.tooltip = BenillaKartFinder_Brief() or "World of Kartcraft" local glow = BenillaKartMinimapButtonGlow if f.check then glow:SetAlpha(0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(GetTime() * 10)) glow:Show() elseif f.queued then glow:SetAlpha(0.4 + 0.3 * math.sin(GetTime() * 3)) glow:Show() else glow:Hide() end if button.dragging then BenillaKartMinimap_Place(BenillaKartMinimap_CursorAngle()) end if button.shownTip ~= button.tooltip and GameTooltip:IsOwned(button) then BenillaKartMinimap_Tooltip() end end
-- The right-click menu, in the stock kit's MENU look. function BenillaKartMinimapMenu_Init() local entries = { { text = "World of Kartcraft", isTitle = 1 }, { text = "Race Finder", func = BenillaKartFinder_Toggle }, { text = "Track browser", func = BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Toggle }, { text = "Leave race", func = BenillaKart_LeaveRace }, } if BenillaKartFinder.queued then table.insert(entries, { text = "Leave queue", func = BenillaKartFinder_QueueClick }) end table.insert(entries, { text = "Kart garage...", func = BenillaKartGarage_Toggle }) table.insert(entries, { text = "Kartcraft settings...", func = BenillaKartSettings_Toggle }) table.insert(entries, { text = "Hide minimap button", func = BenillaKartMinimap_Hide }) for i = 1, table.getn(entries) do entries[i].notCheckable = 1 UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(entries[i]) end end
-- ── The settings window ──
-- A number as a CVar's text: `places` decimals and no trailing zeros, so 1.00 is "1". function BenillaKart_Number(value, places) local text = format("%." .. places .. "f", value) if string.find(text, ".", 1, 1) then text = string.gsub(text, "0+$", "") text = string.gsub(text, "%.$", "") end return text end
-- A numeric setting, written only when it moves. function BenillaKartSettings_Set(cvar, value, places) local text = BenillaKart_Number(value, places) if GetCVar(cvar) ~= text then SetCVar(cvar, text) end end
function BenillaKart_Flag(cvar) if GetCVar(cvar) == "0" then return nil end return 1 end
function BenillaKartSettings_Toggle() if BenillaKartSettingsFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartSettingsFrame:Hide() else BenillaKart_Open(BenillaKartSettingsFrame) end end
-- The controls from the CVars; `refreshing` keeps a slider's echo from writing back. function BenillaKartSettings_Refresh() local frame = BenillaKartSettingsFrame frame.refreshing = 1 BenillaKartSettingsFrameArrowShow:SetChecked(BenillaKart_Flag("KartArrowShow")) BenillaKartSettingsFrameArrowSize:SetValue(tonumber(GetCVar("KartArrowSize")) or 1) BenillaKartSettingsFrameChaseCamera:SetChecked(BenillaKart_Flag("KartChaseCamera")) BenillaKartSettingsFrameMusic:SetChecked(BenillaKart_Flag("KartMusic")) BenillaKartSettingsFrameMusicVolume:SetValue(tonumber(GetCVar("KartMusicVolume")) or 1) BenillaKartSettingsFrameMinimapButton:SetChecked(BenillaKart_Flag("KartMinimapButton")) BenillaKartSettingsFrameGhost:SetChecked(BenillaKart_Flag("KartGhost")) frame.refreshing = nil end
-- A check box's CVar, "1" or "0". function BenillaKartSettings_Check(box, cvar) if box:GetChecked() then SetCVar(cvar, "1") PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") else SetCVar(cvar, "0") PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOff") end if cvar == "KartMinimapButton" then BenillaKartMinimap_Apply() end end
-- A slider's CVar, two decimals. function BenillaKartSettings_Slide(slider, cvar) if BenillaKartSettingsFrame.refreshing then return end BenillaKartSettings_Set(cvar, slider:GetValue(), 2) end
-- A stock options slider's range and labels, set without writing its CVar. function BenillaKartSettings_SetupSlider(slider, label, min, max, step, low, high) BenillaKartSettingsFrame.refreshing = 1 getglobal(slider:GetName() .. "Text"):SetText(label) getglobal(slider:GetName() .. "Low"):SetText(low) getglobal(slider:GetName() .. "High"):SetText(high) slider:SetMinMaxValues(min, max) slider:SetValueStep(step) BenillaKartSettingsFrame.refreshing = nil end
function BenillaKartSettings_ResetArrow() SetCVar("KartArrowX", "0.5") SetCVar("KartArrowY", "0.22") SetCVar("KartArrowSize", "1") BenillaKartSettings_Refresh() end
-- "Move arrow": the window steps aside while the arrow's box is placed, and comes back. function BenillaKartSettings_MoveArrow() BenillaKartArrowMover.reopen = 1 BenillaKartSettingsFrame:Hide() BenillaKartArrowMover:Show() end
-- ── The guide arrow's box: dragged where the arrow goes, the wheel sizes it ──
-- The box's side at size 1, about the arrow's own on a 768-high screen. BENILLA_KART_ARROW_BOX = 90
-- Where KartArrowX and KartArrowY put it (across and down the screen, 0 to 1), as big as -- KartArrowSize. function BenillaKartArrowMover_Place() local frame = BenillaKartArrowMover local x = tonumber(GetCVar("KartArrowX")) or 0.5 local y = tonumber(GetCVar("KartArrowY")) or 0.22 local size = BENILLA_KART_ARROW_BOX * (tonumber(GetCVar("KartArrowSize")) or 1) frame:SetWidth(size) frame:SetHeight(size) frame:ClearAllPoints() frame:SetPoint("CENTER", "UIParent", "TOPLEFT", x * UIParent:GetWidth(), -y * UIParent:GetHeight()) end
function BenillaKartArrowMover_Save() local cx, cy = BenillaKartArrowMover:GetCenter() if not cx then return end BenillaKartSettings_Set("KartArrowX", cx / UIParent:GetWidth(), 4) BenillaKartSettings_Set("KartArrowY", 1 - cy / UIParent:GetHeight(), 4) end
function BenillaKartArrowMover_Wheel(delta) local size = (tonumber(GetCVar("KartArrowSize")) or 1) * math.pow(1.1, delta) if size < 0.4 then size = 0.4 end if size > 3 then size = 3 end BenillaKartSettings_Set("KartArrowSize", size, 2) BenillaKartArrowMover_Place() end
function BenillaKartArrowMover_OnShow() BenillaKartArrowMover_Place() SetCVar("KartArrowMove", "1") end
function BenillaKartArrowMover_OnHide() local frame = BenillaKartArrowMover frame.moving = nil SetCVar("KartArrowMove", "0") if frame.reopen then frame.reopen = nil BenillaKartSettingsFrame:Show() end end
-- ── The garage ──
-- From BENILLA_KART_GARAGE: our Karting skill, the classes { key, name, needs, about } in -- the order the skill opens them, and the racers { key, name } we have a kart for. BenillaKartGarage = { skill = 0, classes = {}, racers = {} } BENILLA_KART_GARAGE_CLASSES = 4 BENILLA_KART_GARAGE_RACERS = 12 BENILLA_KART_LOCKED_COLOR = { r = 0.5, g = 0.5, b = 0.5 }
-- `list`'s lines, each cut at its TABs. function BenillaKart_Rows(list) local rows, from = {}, 1 list = list or "" while from <= string.len(list) do local at = string.find(list, "\n", from, 1) or string.len(list) + 1 table.insert(rows, BenillaKart_Split(string.sub(list, from, at - 1))) from = at + 1 end return rows end
function BenillaKartGarage_Set(skill, classes, racers) local g = BenillaKartGarage g.skill = tonumber(skill) or 0 g.classes = {} local rows = BenillaKart_Rows(classes) for i = 1, table.getn(rows) do local r = rows[i] table.insert(g.classes, { key = r[1], name = r[2] or r[1], needs = tonumber(r[3]) or 0, about = r[4] or "" }) end g.racers = {} rows = BenillaKart_Rows(racers) for i = 1, table.getn(rows) do table.insert(g.racers, { key = rows[i][1], name = rows[i][2] or rows[i][1] }) end if BenillaKartGarageFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartGarage_Refresh() end end
-- A check box's state for SetChecked: 1, or nil to clear it. function BenillaKart_Tick(on) if on then return 1 end return nil end
function BenillaKartGarage_Unlocked(i) local c = BenillaKartGarage.classes[i] return c and BenillaKartGarage.skill >= c.needs end
-- The class the kart drives, as it decides (kart/garage.rs): the one picked if the skill -- has opened it, else the best opened one below it. function BenillaKartGarage_Driven() local classes = BenillaKartGarage.classes local picked = 1 for i = 1, table.getn(classes) do if classes[i].key == GetCVar("KartClass") then picked = i end end for i = picked, 1, -1 do if BenillaKartGarage_Unlocked(i) then return i end end return 1 end
function BenillaKartGarage_Toggle() if BenillaKartGarageFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartGarageFrame:Hide() else BenillaKart_Open(BenillaKartGarageFrame) end end
-- Every row from the garage's lists and the CVars: the driven class and our kart ticked, -- a class the skill has not opened greyed with the skill it needs. function BenillaKartGarage_Refresh() local g = BenillaKartGarage BenillaKartGarageFrameSkill:SetText("Karting skill: " .. g.skill) local driven = BenillaKartGarage_Driven() for i = 1, BENILLA_KART_GARAGE_CLASSES do local box = getglobal("BenillaKartGarageFrameClass" .. i) local text = getglobal(box:GetName() .. "Text") local about = getglobal(box:GetName() .. "About") local c = g.classes[i] if c then box:Show() text:SetText(c.name) box:SetChecked(BenillaKart_Tick(i == driven)) if BenillaKartGarage_Unlocked(i) then box:Enable() text:SetTextColor(NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.r, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.g, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.b) about:SetText(c.about) about:SetTextColor(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b) else box:Disable() text:SetTextColor(BENILLA_KART_LOCKED_COLOR.r, BENILLA_KART_LOCKED_COLOR.g, BENILLA_KART_LOCKED_COLOR.b) about:SetText("Requires Karting (" .. c.needs .. ")") about:SetTextColor(RED_FONT_COLOR.r, RED_FONT_COLOR.g, RED_FONT_COLOR.b) end else box:Hide() end end for i = 1, BENILLA_KART_GARAGE_RACERS do local box = getglobal("BenillaKartGarageFrameRacer" .. i) local r = g.racers[i] if r then box:Show() getglobal(box:GetName() .. "Text"):SetText(r.name) box:SetChecked(BenillaKart_Tick(r.key == GetCVar("KartRacer"))) else box:Hide() end end if table.getn(g.racers) == 0 then BenillaKartGarageFrameNoKarts:Show() else BenillaKartGarageFrameNoKarts:Hide() end end
-- A class row clicked: picked if the skill has opened it. function BenillaKartGarage_PickClass(i) local c = BenillaKartGarage.classes[i] if c and BenillaKartGarage_Unlocked(i) then SetCVar("KartClass", c.key) PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") end BenillaKartGarage_Refresh() end
function BenillaKartGarage_PickRacer(i) local r = BenillaKartGarage.racers[i] if r then SetCVar("KartRacer", r.key) PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") end BenillaKartGarage_Refresh() end
-- The heartbeat, and the end of a ready check nobody answered. function BenillaKartEvents_OnUpdate() BenillaKartMinimap_Update() local f = BenillaKartFinder if (f.queued or f.check) and GetTime() >= f.beat then f.beat = GetTime() + BENILLA_KART_HEARTBEAT BenillaKart_Send("W") end end -- The stock tables last, and only where they exist: a load without the stock interface -- (a dev build's harness) still defines everything above. if StaticPopupDialogs then StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_KART_READY"] = { text = "Race ready: %s (%d racers).\nJoin it?", button1 = ACCEPT, button2 = DECLINE, timeout = 20, whileDead = 1, hideOnEscape = 1, OnAccept = function() BenillaKartFinder_Answer(1) end, OnCancel = function() BenillaKartFinder_Answer(nil) end, } -- After a Race Finder race, as the dungeon finder offers the way out of a dungeon. StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_KART_RETURN"] = { text = "Return to where you were before the race?", button1 = "Return", button2 = "Stay", timeout = 0, whileDead = 1, hideOnEscape = 1, OnAccept = function() BenillaKart_Send("Back") end, OnCancel = function() BenillaKart_Send("Stay") end, } end if SlashCmdList then SLASH_BENILLA_RACEFINDER1 = "/racefinder" SlashCmdList["BENILLA_RACEFINDER"] = function() BenillaKartFinder_Toggle() end -- Out of every race and the queue, whatever the kart or the server thinks. SLASH_BENILLA_LEAVERACE1 = "/leaverace" SLASH_BENILLA_LEAVERACE2 = "/lr" SlashCmdList["BENILLA_LEAVERACE"] = function() BenillaKart_LeaveRace() end SLASH_BENILLA_KARTCRAFT1 = "/kartcraft" SlashCmdList["BENILLA_KARTCRAFT"] = function() BenillaKartSettings_Toggle() end SLASH_BENILLA_TRACKS1 = "/tracks" SlashCmdList["BENILLA_TRACKS"] = function() BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Toggle() end SLASH_BENILLA_GARAGE1 = "/garage" SlashCmdList["BENILLA_GARAGE"] = function() BenillaKartGarage_Toggle() end -- GMs: the Race Finder's wait for a second racer, in seconds (the server checks). SLASH_BENILLA_RACEWAIT1 = "/racewait" SlashCmdList["BENILLA_RACEWAIT"] = function(msg) BenillaKart_Send("FillWait\t" .. (string.gsub(msg or "", "%D", ""))) end end

Scripts.OnLoad: -- The label is the check template's; Escape closes it, as it does a stock panel. local label = getglobal(this:GetName() .. "AnyText") if label then label:SetText("Any course") end if UISpecialFrames then table.insert(UISpecialFrames, this:GetName()) end BenillaKart_Movable(this) this:EnableMouseWheel(1)

-- Each box's CVar and label (the check template's), and each slider's range. local boxes = { { "ArrowShow", "KartArrowShow", "Show the guide arrow in a race" }, { "ChaseCamera", "KartChaseCamera", "CTR chase camera (off: your WoW camera)" }, { "Music", "KartMusic", "Play CTR race music" }, { "MinimapButton", "KartMinimapButton", "Show the minimap button" }, { "Ghost", "KartGhost", "Race the ghost of your best run" }, } for i = 1, table.getn(boxes) do local box = getglobal(this:GetName() .. boxes[i][1]) box.cvar = boxes[i][2] getglobal(box:GetName() .. "Text"):SetText(boxes[i][3]) end BenillaKartSettings_SetupSlider(BenillaKartSettingsFrameArrowSize, "Arrow size", 0.4, 3, 0.1, "Small", "Large") BenillaKartSettings_SetupSlider(BenillaKartSettingsFrameMusicVolume, "Music volume", 0, 1, 0.05, "Quiet", "Loud") if UISpecialFrames then table.insert(UISpecialFrames, this:GetName()) end BenillaKart_Movable(this)
